title: Lada Kesseler | Emerging Patterns for Coding with Generative AI
description:
This is a teaser for Lada Kessleler's (Lead Developer at Logic20/20) full session at AI Native DevCon Fall, November 18–19.

Coding with AI can feel magical one moment and maddening the next. This workshop maps out the emerging patterns that make AI-assisted development more powerful, predictable, and practical — from first experiments to advanced techniques.

You’ll learn how to:

- Understand the inherent limits of generative AI — and how to work with them
- Apply proven patterns to make AI coding agents reliable in production
- Combine techniques to create your own solutions for complex codebases

Build lasting intuition for how and why AI succeeds (or fails) at real-world coding

Featuring:
Lada Kesseler, Lead Developer at Logic20/20
and a special preview of Ray Myers’ session from AI Native DevCon — Chief Architect at OpenHands, legacy code specialist, and host of Empathy in Tech.

Full AI Native DevCon (Nov 18–19, NYC + Virtual)
Two days of deep dives on MCP, evals, memory engineering, and AI-native workflows — with speakers from GitHub, Google, Microsoft, Hugging Face, and more.
